item.villagers.relic.kingsmaul.lore.2: Hits slow foes heavily and knock them back.

item.villagers.relic.last_mantle.lore.2: Once per in-game day, survive one killing blow at 1 HP.

No fall damage; Dolphin's Grace while in water.
